meta.targetWindow: 15–22 Feb 2027 (7 nights, 2 adults). The preferred short trip is 15–18 Feb 2027 (3 nights).
meta.roomStandard: The main shortlist includes named Queen- or King-bed room types with a private bathroom confirmed on a primary property page. Date-specific availability can still change.
meta.bookingReality: Booking.com returned dated 15–22 Feb 2027 snapshots for 8 of the 10 qualifying properties. Each total is an aggregator observation, not a hotel quote; capture dates and rate-plan terms are stated per row. Two properties remain unpriced.
meta.rankingPolicy: No hotel ranking or one-hour score is asserted from incomplete routing. The table contains only hotels with a sourced Queen+ room and private bathroom; six earlier MICHELIN candidates are omitted pending the same room-level evidence (see F20).
meta.ratePolicy: sevenNightTotal is the quoted Booking.com pre-tax room amount for 2 adults / 7 nights; mandatory resort fees are included where the page says so. Rate plans, taxes and fixed fees are described in taxBasis. Full checkout totals were not captured, so allInSevenNights is intentionally blank and no assumed tax arithmetic is presented. rateCapturedOn is per row.
meta.rateWindow: 15 Feb 2027 check-in to 22 Feb 2027 check-out; one room; two adults. No other date window is compared, so cheapestWindow stays blank.
